Messages.Author: Jeffrey Endres
Messages.Body:
Great card, just a few things we want worked out, is the minion with the
Blessing of Chaos affected by The Sleeping Mind?

It is a very pecular timing thing. I would say that the minion is not
meant to be affected by The Sleeping Mind.

There is another Question with regards to Coma to follow.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Jeffrey Endres wrote:
>
> <...> is the minion with the

> Blessing of Chaos affected by The Sleeping Mind?

Yes. Sleeping Mind is not an action, so is not restricted by
the superior, and the Blessed minion is not attempting to block
when the action is announced (when Sleeping Mind is played), so
doesn't restrict the play of Sleeping Mind then, either.
